main.description: A single, mutable per-account streak/stats record, edited in place like a profile. It also doubles as AT Mot's declaration / signaling record: its presence signals that an account plays AT Mot, and its deletion signals opt-out. Listing this one collection across the network enumerates every AT Mot player, so it is created on first play even before any stats accrue.

byLang.description: Per-language statistics. Optional and possibly empty (e.g. on the first declaration write before any game completes).

updatedAt.description: When this record was last updated.

langStats.description: Streak and aggregate statistics for one language series.

currentStreak.description: Consecutive solved puzzles up to the most recent played puzzle.

maxStreak.description: Longest streak ever achieved in this language.

gamesPlayed.description: Total puzzles completed (won or lost) in this language.

gamesWon.description: Total puzzles solved in this language.

lastPuzzleNumber.description: Puzzle number of the most recent completed puzzle, used to detect streak breaks.

guessDistribution.description: Histogram of winning guess counts. Each element is an object (not a bare integer) so context can be added later without a schema V2.

guessBucket.description: One bucket of the guess-count histogram.

guesses.description: Number of guesses it took to win (1–6).

count.description: How many wins used exactly this many guesses.
